AirflowTotals.description:
An airflow: infiltration, or the base of outdoor air (R9, FR-018, FR-019).

Attributes:
    design_flow: Σ design flow, m³/s.
    hourly: Σ flow per hour, m³/s.
    constant_weighted: Σ design flow · constant coefficient (infiltration).
    temperature_weighted: Σ design flow · temperature coefficient.
    velocity_weighted: Σ design flow · velocity coefficient.
    velocity_squared_weighted: Σ design flow · velocity-squared coefficient.
    design_days: Σ design flow · schedule on the design days, weighted by `design_flow`
        (infiltration; outdoor air comes from run-period results and has none).

hourly.description:
A profile (for example 8760 hourly values) stored compactly in a JSON file.

hourly.title: EncodedProfile

AirflowTotals.title: AirflowTotals

BuildingBlock.description:
Building facts `merge` needs without the model (R6).

Attributes:
    conditioned_floor_area: Σ floor area of the conditioned zones, multipliers applied, m².
    storey_ratio: Conditioned floor area ÷ floor area of the lowest level, unrounded.
    calendar: The run-period calendar of the profiles; `None` in a report that does not
        record it, which `merge` refuses.
    mains_temperature: The annual-mean mains water temperature, °C, or `None` without hot water.
    air_density: The standard air density of the fan volumes, kg/m³, or `None` when not recorded.

CalendarBlock.description:

    custom_day_1: Dates marked `CustomDay1`, sorted.
    custom_day_2: Dates marked `CustomDay2`, sorted.
CalendarBlock.title: CalendarBlock

DesignDays.description:
A schedule-driven profile on the summer and winter design days (24 values each).

The days are summed with the same weights as the run-period profile they accompany, and
`weight` is the part of the parent's weight (installed level, design flow or area) they
cover. A total whose design days cover less than its weight, such as the sum of a member
with design days and one without, has no complete design days (`complete`), and its
schedules keep the builder's design days. Design days are not run-period profiles: the
ledger's single-length rule leaves them out.

Attributes:
    weight: Σ weight of the members whose design days are known.
    summer: Σ weight · value on the summer design day, per hour.
    winter: Σ weight · value on the winter design day, per hour.

EirSums.description:
The additive sums of R12's constrained fit `c_h = (a + b·(T_h - T_ref))·d_h`.

Each sum runs over (zone, hour) pairs, with d the delivered and c the consumed energy (J)
and T the outdoor dry-bulb temperature (°C).

Attributes:
    d: Σ d.
    d_t: Σ d·T.
    d2: Σ d².
    d2_t: Σ d²·T.
    d2_t2: Σ d²·T².
    c: Σ c.
    c_d: Σ c·d.
    c_d_t: Σ c·d·T.
EirSums.title: EirSums

EnergyTotals.description:
Delivered and consumed energy of one mode (R12, FR-022).

Attributes:
    delivered: Σ delivered energy, J.
    consumed_by_fuel: Σ consumed energy of the primary meters per fuel, J.
    distribution_by_fuel: Σ pump and heat-rejection energy folded into this mode per fuel, J.
        Fans are not folded here: their energy is in `FanTotals` and is written as
        `SpecificFanPower` (R19).
    unattributed: Consumption in hours without delivery (standby, pilot) per fuel, J.
    rated_weight: Σ weight of the rated efficiencies (for example rated capacity).
    rated_weighted: Σ weight · rated efficiency, from *Equipment Summary*.
    eir_sums: The sums of the energy-input-ratio fit.
EnergyTotals.title: EnergyTotals

EnvelopeAssignment.description:
Envelope of an excluded zone assigned to a conditioned member (R6, R8, FR-013).

The assigned totals themselves are added to the member's `envelope`; this records where
they came from, for the report.

Attributes:
    source_zone: The excluded zone (plenum, attic, crawlspace...).
    target_zone: The conditioned zone that receives the envelope.
    envelope_class: The class of the assigned surfaces.
    area: The area assigned, m² (extensive).
    share: The target's share of the source's envelope of that class, by shared area.
EnvelopeAssignment.title: EnvelopeAssignment

EnvelopeTotals.description:
One opaque surface class of a group (R6, FR-016, FR-017).

Attributes:
    area: Σ net area, m².
    ua: Σ area · U with films, W/K.
    capacity_inner: Σ heat capacity inside each construction's most resistive layer, J/K.
    capacity_outer: Σ heat capacity outside it, J/K.
    area_by_orientation: Σ area per orientation sector, m².
EnvelopeTotals.title: EnvelopeTotals

ExcludedZone.description:
A zone in no group (FR-013, R8).

Attributes:
    zone: The zone name.
    multiplier: Its multiplier.
    floor_area: The floor area of one copy, m².
    role: `attic`, `basement` or `excluded` (plenums, unconditioned spaces).
    reason: Why, in words.
    envelope: Where its envelope went, sorted.
ExcludedZone.title: ExcludedZone

FanTotals.description:
Fan energy and air volume (R19, FR-022a).

Attributes:
    energy: Σ fan electricity, J.
    volume: Σ air volume at standard density, m³.
    volume_in_mode: Σ air volume in hours of each mode, m³.
    delivered_in_mode: Σ delivered energy in those hours, J.
    volume_without_demand: Σ air volume in hours with neither load nor outdoor-air demand, m³.
FanTotals.title: FanTotals

GainTotals.description:
One kind of internal gain (FR-015).

Attributes:
    installed: Σ design level: W, or people for occupancy.
    hourly: Σ design level · schedule, per hour (W, or people).
    radiant: Annual radiant energy, J.
    latent: Annual latent energy, J.
    lost: Annual energy lost to the zone (lost fraction, and lights' return-air fraction), J.
    design_days: Σ design level · schedule on the design days, weighted by `installed`.
    activity: For people, the annual heat their activity level gives off, Σ people ·
        schedule · activity (W per person) · 3600 s, J; 0 when unknown and for other kinds.
        Divided by the occupant-hours (Σ `hourly` · 3600 s) it is the mean W per person.

GroupLedger.description:
The conserved totals of a group of zones (data-model.md: GroupLedger).

Attributes:
    members: The zone names, sorted (FR-025 provenance).
    floor_area: Σ floor area, multipliers applied, m² (FR-014).
    envelope: Opaque totals per surface class (FR-016, FR-017).
    window_by_orientation: Totals of the windows in walls (60° to 120° tilt) per orientation
        (FR-016, FR-024).
    skylights: Totals of the other windows (skylights, roof and floor windows), kept out of
        the facade (FR-016).
    internal_mass_capacity: Σ heat capacity of internal mass, J/K (FR-017).
    internal_mass_area: Σ exposed area of internal mass, m².
    gains: Totals per gain kind (FR-015).
    infiltration: Infiltration (FR-018).
    outdoor_air: Mechanical outdoor air with HRV and economiser categories (FR-019).
    heating_setpoint: Area-weighted heating setpoint of the heated members (FR-020).
    cooling_setpoint: Area-weighted cooling setpoint of the cooled members (FR-020).
    unheated_area: Σ floor area of members not heated, m².
    uncooled_area: Σ floor area of members not cooled, m².
    hot_water: Domestic hot water (FR-021).
    energy: Delivered and consumed energy per mode (FR-022).
    fans: Fan energy and air volume (FR-022a).
    excluded_envelope: Envelope of excluded zones assigned to members, sorted (FR-013).
GroupLedger.title: GroupLedger

Layout.description:
How conditioned zones are grouped into SBEM zone groups.

Attributes:
    SPACE_USE_EXPOSURE: One group per space use and exposure (the default, the finest).
    SPACE_USE: One group per space use.
    CORE_PERIMETER: One group per exposure.
    SINGLE_ZONE: One group for the whole building (the coarsest).
Layout.title: Layout

MergedDistinction.description:
For a coarser layout, which finest keys one resulting group merges (US2; read by spec 003).

Attributes:
    into_key: The resulting group's key.
    from_keys: The finest keys merged into it, sorted.
    lost: The distinctions lost, in group-key order.
MergedDistinction.title: MergedDistinction

NotRepresented.description:
One entry of the report's `not_represented[]` (data-model.md, ReductionReport; FR-026).

Attributes:
    feature: What is not represented, in words (`"Daylighting controls"`, `"Fan energy"`).
    effect: What it does in the detailed model.
    object_type: The EnergyPlus object type, when the entry comes from one.
    objects: The names of the objects found, sorted.
    affected_zones: The zones it affects, sorted (model spelling).
    affected_groups: The groups it affects, sorted; filled by the report once zones are
        grouped, empty before.
    magnitude: Its size, such as the annual energy, or `None` when the results do not give
        it.
    unit: The unit of `magnitude` (`"J"` for energy), or `None`.
    folded_into: The SBEM parameter its effect is folded into, or `None` when it is dropped.
    source: R20's table (`"unsupported_features"`) or the module that folded it.
NotRepresented.title: NotRepresented

Attributes:

PreThresholdGroup.title: PreThresholdGroup

ReductionOptions.description:
The options of a reduction. Frozen: derive variants with `model_copy(update=...)`.

Attributes:
    layout: How conditioned zones are grouped.
    small_group_threshold: A share of conditioned floor area in [0, 1). A group smaller
        than this share is merged into its most similar eligible group.
    space_use_mapping: Zone name to space use, overriding the space use reduction
        infers (research R4). `None` infers every space use.

small_group_threshold.description: a share of conditioned floor area in [0, 1)
small_group_threshold.title: Small Group Threshold

ReductionOptions.title: ReductionOptions

ReportGroup.description:
One SBEM zone group of the archetype.

Attributes:
    name: The group's name, unique; `group_name(key)` by default.
    key: The group key of the layout (`Layout.group_key`).
    members: The zones, sorted by name.
    floor_area: Σ floor area, multipliers applied, m² (equals `ledger.floor_area`).
    floor_area_share: `floor_area / Σ floor_area` over the groups (rule `area.share`).
    ledger: The group's conserved totals.
ReportGroup.title: ReportGroup

Reproducibility.description:
What a reduction needs to be repeated (invariant 6; research R14).

Attributes:
    archetypal: The version of archetypal.
    epinterface: The version of epinterface (the SBEM fork).
    idfkit: The version of idfkit.
    energyplus: The EnergyPlus version of the model and results, `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`.
    model_sha256: SHA-256 of the model.
    results_sha256: SHA-256 of the SQLite results.
    weather_sha256: SHA-256 of the weather file, or `None` without one.
    options: The reduction's options; a space-use mapping is held sorted by zone.
Reproducibility.title: Reproducibility

The report of a reduction (data-model.md, ReductionReport; contracts/reduction-report.md).

    reproducibility: Versions, input hashes and options.
